thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: BILLING-METERING-DRIFT detected for prod, token aggregation diverging from ledger. Severity: P1. Alerts: overage-flag spike. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/metering-drift. Pager: oncall-sre.
Alex: ack — I'm oncall, looking at the metric panels now.
Jamie: I'm nearby, joining the call. What metric window?
Alex: divergence starts ~2024-03-15T02:08Z. Aggregate tokens > ledger tokens by ~14% on 1h rolling. Quick query snapshot:```sql
SELECT sum(tokens) as agg_tokens FROM emit_stream WHERE minute >= '2024-03-15T01:00' GROUP BY minute;
-- agg_tokens ~ 1,142,331
SELECT sum(tokens) as ledger_tokens FROM billing_ledger WHERE minute >= '2024-03-15T01:00' GROUP BY minute;
-- ledger_tokens ~ 999,021
```
Priya: billing-eng here — saw the alert. No billing deploy in last 8h on prod. Could be emitter duplication or consumer replays. Checking emitter retry logs now.
Alex: kafka consumer-lag spikes on topic 'usage-emitter' partition 12 ~120k lag around 02:10Z, plus a burst of retries from emitter-frontend. Dashboards: https://dash/redwood/metering/compare
Jamie: if replays are in-flight we might double-count at aggregation layer; ledger dedupe runs downstream — that explains agg > ledger. Suggest temporarily suppressing emitter-retries at edge and enable passive shadow mode for real-time counters.
Alex: executing suppression:```bash
# flip emitter retry throttle
kubectl -n prod set env deployment/emitter RETRY_BACKOFF=600
# disable realtime shadow writes
curl -X POST "$MGR_API/flags" -d '{"metering_realtime_passthrough":false}'
```
Priya: good call. Starting a targeted dedupe pass on outstanding emitter txns (script: tools/dedupe_inflight.sh). I will also audit idempotency keys. ETA ~25m.
Theo: support — any customer-visible overage notifications fired? I see a small batch of 'possible overage' emails in the queue (IDs: 5467, 5541, 5599). I've paused the notifications webhook to prevent more.
Lina: product — we need quick triage on enterprise customers. Are committed-capacity customers at risk for incorrect charges? If so we must notify accounts.
Priya: preliminary estimate: exposure is small (~0.6–1.0% of yesterday's tokens), concentrated to a handful of customers on real-time routes. Ledger will likely reconcile final counts; the immediate risk is false overage flags rather than actual billing errors. We'll prepare provisional credits if needed.
Jamie: I pinned the alert to suppress repeated pagers while we stabilize. Also enabled window smoothing (config: smoothing.window=30s) to absorb bursty duplicates.
Alex: summary for handoff — root cause hypothesis: emitter retry storm + consumer-lag causing duplicate events to be aggregated before ledger dedupe. Mitigations applied: throttle emitter retries, pause notification webhook, start dedupe job, enable smoothing. Links: runbook, dash, logs.
Alex: handing off the thread to night oncall @morgan in 30m. Full notes in incident doc: https://go/incidents/1722223333
Morgan: ack — I'll pick this up for the night. Will monitor the dedupe job, ledger reconciliation, and ensure CS has any customer comms draft.
Priya: will post dedupe job results and a small reconciliation table when done.
Incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2 — mitigations in place and no new overage emails after pause.
Morgan: on it, I will confirm lash-up by 03:30Z and post a final afteraction with credits plan if reconciliation shows false positives.
